title: Kohath
summary: Son of Levi (Gen 46:11); father of Amram; lived 133 years (Exod 6:18).

sorting_basis.note: No tier 1-4 dates this record's birth; unsorted (null).

standby.note: Standby placement only. Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology (1830, 2nd ed.) prints this BC/AD year on the birth entry (5. Kohath 60 1863). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.
